## Teaching points

1. A painless focal subconjunctival bleed with preserved acuity after coughing usually clears spontaneously. Assess trauma and blood pressure.
2. Reassurance follows a normal visual assessment and exclusion of trauma or other concerning symptoms.
3. Check blood pressure and medication/bleeding history; recurrent bleeding may need further assessment.
4. The red patch resolves gradually rather than during the ED visit. New pain or visual change warrants reassessment.
